Union Minister Offers Political Entry to Abhijit Dipke

A Union Minister has extended an invitation to Abhijit Dipke to join the BJP-led NDA. The minister urged Dipke to fulfill Ambedkar's dream, stating that their government is one that aims to do so. The organization CJP is reportedly seeking to rally individuals described as 'intellectual Naxals', potentially utilizing a 'cockroach formula' attributed to Abhijit Dipke.
